title: GHSL Built-up Surface Grid GHS-BUILT-S R2023A (1975-2030)
description: Global raster of built-up surface (square metres of built-up area per cell), total and non-residential, from the Joint Research Centre's Global Human Settlement Layer. Epochs 1975-2030 at 5-year intervals at 100 m and 1 km (Mollweide) and 3/30 arc-seconds (WGS84), plus a 10 m layer for the 2018 Sentinel-2 anchor epoch.
purpose: Long-term, consistent measure of urban and settlement expansion across Algeria (coastal metropolitan growth, new towns, Saharan oasis cities) and an exposure layer for hazard assessments.

spatial_extent.description: Global. Distributed as global files or tiles; Algeria must be clipped by the user.

temporal_extent.description: Epochs 1975, 1980, ..., 2030 (5-year steps) at 100 m / 1 km / 3 and 30 arc-seconds. Observed anchor epochs: Landsat 1975, 1990, 2000, 2014 and Sentinel-2 2018; other epochs are spatio-temporally interpolated, and 2025/2030 are extrapolations. The 10 m layer exists only for 2018.

resolution.spatial: 100 m and 1 km (Mollweide); 3 and 30 arc-seconds (WGS84); 10 m for 2018

crs: World Mollweide (EPSG:54009); WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for 3 and 30 arc-second versions

variables.name: BUILT_S (total)
variables.description: Built-up surface; 100 m: uint16 range 0-10,000, NoData 65535; 1 km: uint32 range 0-1,000,000; 10 m (2018): uint8 0-100, NoData 255

variables.name: BUILT_S NRES
variables.description: Built-up surface allocated to dominant non-residential uses

processing: Built-up surface fraction is estimated at 10 m from a Sentinel-2 composite (2018) using a learning set from GHS-BUILT-S2 R2020A, Facebook, Microsoft and OpenStreetMap building delineations and associative rule learning on quantized image features; Landsat (MSS, TM, ETM) supports the 1975, 1990, 2000 and 2014 epochs. Values for 5-year epochs 1975-2030 are obtained by spatio-temporal interpolation/extrapolation with rank-optimal spatial allocation using slope, elevation, distance to water and vegetation, and observed built-up dynamics.
validation: GHSL Data Package 2023 (section 2.1.2) reports, from the first tranche of 250,000 visually interpreted reference points for the 2018 Sentinel-2 predictions, a 4-class overall accuracy of 82.6% (voting schema) and 90.5% on the 155,649 high-confidence/high-agreement points; Boolean built-up vs non-built-up accuracy improved from 75.47% (R2019) to 94.04% (R2022/R2023) on the same reference data, and 100 m continuous built-up surface MAE dropped from 0.117 to 0.035. These are global figures, not Algeria-specific.
limitations: Epochs other than the observed anchor years are interpolated; 2025 and 2030 are model extrapolations, not observations.
Bright bare soils, rock and sand in arid regions can be confused with built-up surfaces in optical classification; Algeria-specific accuracy is not reported.
Residential vs non-residential split is a model abstraction and should not be read as land-use cadastre.
Large global files (e.g. the 2020 3 arc-second zip is about 3.2 GB); Mollweide versions need reprojection for most web maps.
